levels.surface: جعفر بن محمد بن إبراهيم الموسوي
جعفر بن محمد بن حكيم الخثعمي

notes: three isnads, each ending «عن أبي الحسن (ع) مثله» in its own words: separate routes of the same saying, so separate groups and a null tail (rule 4)
in the first route «قال سألته» is the first person of an unnamed questioner: the last link is not settled (rule 11)
«حدثني أبي ره» is a relation at the start of the third route (rule 7); the blessing «ره» is left out
«2» is the report number and is left out
